title: Supplementary code for: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: Scripts, certificates, run logs and Lean 4 verifications supporting the paper. The package contains the exact chamber certificates of the single-deviation bound, the covering bound at every contact count, the root-system meets and the 600-cell enumeration, the slack continuation, and the three-point semidefinite certificate for the twenty-three-contact case together with its verification in exact rational arithmetic, interval arithmetic and Lean 4. It carries the two steps of the certificate of de Laat, Leijenhorst and de Muinck Keizer for the twenty-four-contact case that their own verification code leaves out, the construction of the zonal matrices and the four polynomial identities, recomputed from their published data in exact rational arithmetic on an ordinary machine. It also contains the distance criterion for neighbours that do not touch the centre (shell_reduction.py, in ball arithmetic) and a numerical search of the case it leaves open (shell_neighbour_search.py); the verification of the local bound whenever at most twenty-three centres lie within sqrt 6, whatever their distances (labelled_certificate_check.py, in ball and interval arithmetic); the exact content of the section on further reductions (closure_lemmas.py, and in Lean 4 lean/D4Closure.lean); the explicit constant epsilon_0 = 4e-26 of the near-contact theorem (explicit_eps0.py, in ball and exact arithmetic); the three-point certificate on an enlarged domain showing that no 25 points of S^3 have pairwise inner products at most 1/2 + 0.0065, so that the kissing number in dimension four is stable (certify_cardinality.py, in exact and interval arithmetic); and an independent re-verification of every computation of the paper. The re-verification and these programs were developed, and their computations run, with the assistance of Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic.
